r: **AP Employment of Local Candidates in Industries/Factories Act**
**75% of private-sector jobs** in industries/factories reserved for **locals** – AP the **first State** to do so; criticised nationally as a **deterrent to investors**
**100** days of wage work; Centre paid **100%** of unskilled wages
Began **1 Jul 2026**; national launch at **Mukkavaripalli (Tirupati district)**
**125 days**; pause up to **60 days** in peak farm season; **60:40** Centre:State
AP **3rd** nationally – **1,635.10 lakh person-days** (labour budget **1,800** lakh)
Funding **90:10**; unit value **₹19 lakh in tribal areas**
AP unemployment **4.1%** (all ages); **youth unemployment ~17.5%**, far **above** the national level
**PMKVY 4.0** – Industry 4.0 courses (**coding, AI, robotics, mechatronics, IoT, 3D printing, drones**, soft skills)
Foundation stone laid by the PM at **Kanpur** (Dec **2016**), on the Singapore ITE model
All **83 Govt ITIs** of AP to be upgraded as **16 hubs + 67 spokes**
"Youth Empowerment through AI and Digital Skills"
Skills Strengthening for Industrial Value Enhancement
Skill Acquisition and Knowledge Awareness for Livelihood Promotion
Scheme for Higher Education Youth in Apprenticeship and Skills
Scheme for Trans-disciplinary Research for India's Developing Economy
AP State Skill Development Corporation – set up **2014** as a not-for-profit company on the lines of **NSDC**
**Nodal agency for placement-linked training** via **Skill Hubs, Skill Spokes**, colleges and **Sector Skill Councils**
**70% placement** minimum for all State skill schemes
APSSDC with **Siemens** in engineering colleges (e.g. **JNTU Anantapur**)
All skill departments into one **Commissionerate of Skill, Employment and Training**; motto "**One District – One Skill**"
**1,11,159** trained in Employability Skill Centres; **PM Internship Scheme**: **72,481** enrolments
**Prakasam** district won a 2nd-edition **Award for Excellence in District Skill Development Planning (DSDP)**
Skill training that placed **rural youth in private-sector jobs**
AI portal: **skilling, certification and job matching**; goal **20 lakh by 2029**
**German (A1–B2)** training for overseas jobs, mainly nurses; LoI (**6 May 2026**) with **Japan's FVCC**
Household survey of the **skills, qualifications and jobs of 100% of youth**
Allowance for educated youth, **2014–19 TDP** government
Employability-linked **skill development for unemployed SC youth**; target **30,000 SC youth**
**SERP** – AP **1st in India in SHG-bank linkage**
Loans to SHG members up to **₹1 lakh at 11%**
Upper age limit for govt jobs
Renamed **Swarna Gramam and Swarna Ward** department; staff as Village Skill Officers
**Overseas Manpower Company AP Ltd** – agency under the **Emigration Act, 1983**
Must go via OMCAP – **over 90%** of abuse complaints come from those who did not
